entities.summary: Mic Sokoli was an Albanian guerrilla fighter from the Highlands of Gjakova. He fought in the Battle of Nokshiq against the Montenegrins, and was a notable fighter of the League of Prizren, having fought in Gjakova against Mehmet Ali Pasha. He is remembered by Albanians for an act of heroism in April 1881, in which he sacrificed himself by pressing his body against the mouth of an Ottoman cannon.
